## Validation

Command run:

```powershell
py -3 scripts\build-reforger-extended-api-reference.py
py -3 scripts\audit-references.py --skip-review
Select-String -Path SKILL.md,references\*.md -Pattern 'raw/|raw\\|Sources Used|Source files|Raw source'
Select-String -Path references\*.md -Pattern '\[image omitted\]|Official Wiki Sources|High-Signal Doc Notes|Official Sample Sources|Relevant APIs|Headings:|TODO:'
```

Results:

- `SKILL.md` passes the audit.
- All runtime references now meet the audit's hard structural minimum line floor.
- All topical references still warn as below the design's useful-detail range.
- All topical references still fail concept coverage because no required concepts are parsed from `generation/design.md`.
- `references/api-extended.md` still fails hygiene checks for generated source artifacts: two `TODO:` strings from generated workshop API comments, an `ā` encoding marker, and a flattened inline table near line 10117.
- Runtime raw-provenance search only reported `references/resources-prefabs-configs.md` text `Rebuild/process imported assets...`, which is not a local raw path, plus generated API source paths in `references/api-extended.md`.
